question: What does the current system do over a sustained period with nothing changed underneath it, and how much of any difference between two identically-configured accounts is just noise?
hypothesis: base_a and base_b start from identical equity ($100,000.00 each, verified against Alpaca on 2026-09-08) and load the same config file, so they will differ only by noise - and that difference IS the noise floor every later A/B must clear. base_mixed will not separate from the pair by more than that noise. We do not expect the fleet to beat the judged week's +5.10%, and we are not trying to. Compare the pair on dollar P&L and decision agreement, not percentage alone.
